links.outcome: Readability (FRES, FKGL) of chatbot testosterone replacement therapy answers for patients
links.effect: Even the most readable chatbot, Perplexity AI, produced text at about an eleventh-grade level. ChatGPT and Perplexity differed significantly on FRES and FKGL.
links.quote: Despite Perplexity scoring higher in readability, the generated text still maintained an eleventh-grade complexity.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality, readability, and understandability of responses from four generative AI chatbots to consumer health questions regarding testosterone replacement therapy using validated instruments without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
